text:
Ravi (Partnerships): FYI CloudX sent a prototype Terraform provider (not just modules). They want us to package it into our marketplace refkit and provide sample templates. Can we do a quick ops/packaging handoff this week?

Kelsey (Cloud): Thanks — can you drop the repo link and a short acceptance checklist? We need registry metadata for the marketplace listing. :eyes:

Ravi (Partnerships): Repo: https://git.partner-cloudx.com/cloudx/terraform-provider-cloudx (private). Quick checklist: 
- provider lint + basic unit tests
- publishable artifact (zip + checksum)
- registry / namespace naming decision
- example refkit templates (1x quickstart, 1x multi-AZ)
- CI that runs fmt/validate/acceptance
- security review kickoff

Jamie (Eng): I can take provider packaging and CI. Do we want to follow HashiCorp registry conventions (namespace = redwood/cloudx) or keep partner namespace?

Alex (Solutions): Prefer redwood/cloudx for discoverability in our refkits, but mark partner-maintained. We'll add a note in console that maintenance is CloudX with contact info.

Sam (DevEx): For sample TF snippets, let's add a standardized quickstart. Example provider block to include in refkit README: 

```hcl
terraform {
  required_providers {
    cloudx = {
      source  = "redwood/cloudx"
      version = "~> 0.1"
    }
  }
}

provider "cloudx" {
  api_key = var.cloudx_api_key
  region  = var.region
}

resource "cloudx_inference_pool" "example" {
  name      = "redwood-example"
  gpu_count = 4
  instance_type = "g4dn.xlarge"
}
```

Ravi (Partnerships): Nice. CloudX asked if we can include a tiny smoke test that provisions + destroys a minimal pool in CI (on a partner sandbox account). Is that acceptable?

Jamie (Eng): That's fine but we'll gate it behind a flag and run only on partner CI runners. For open-source refkit we can include a mocked acceptance test using localstack-style shim.

Kelsey (Cloud): For marketplace metadata, I'll prepare JSON schema for listing: title, short_desc, supported_regions, verified_size_profiles, recommended_quantization. I'll also add a pointer to our RBAC docs for private deployments.

Sam (DevEx): A couple operational notes:
- naming: use provider name "cloudx" and module prefix "redwood/cloudx/*" for refkit modules
- add examples for both Dedicated and Hosted routes (how to pin model versions)
- include a small section on cost expectations for common workloads

deploy-bot: CI pipeline started for branch packaging/ci-setup — build #4821 queued.

Ravi (Partnerships): Great. Action items: 
- Jamie: packaging + CI (owner)
- Kelsey: marketplace metadata + listing schema
- Sam: refkit README + quickstart snippets
- Alex: console/solutions blurb and partner contact details
- Ravi: coordinate security review and partner comms

Jamie (Eng): I'll open a PR later today with a draft GitHub Actions workflow and packaging script. Will include a small acceptance flag and a mocked test target.

Kelsey (Cloud): I'll drop the marketplace JSON and sample screenshots by EOD tomorrow.

Sam (DevEx): I'll write the README quickstart and a minimal multi-AZ example, keep it <200 lines.

Ravi (Partnerships): Thanks team. I'll schedule a 30m handoff call with CloudX and invite the owners. :calendar:

Alex (Solutions): Thumbs up. If we can get the provider into our refkit this sprint, we should plan a short joint blog + partner announcement for next month.

Ravi (Partnerships): Noted. Tracking in #partnerships-roadmap and I'll update external roadmap for CloudX integration.
